description: regularize requires a policy key that the existing quantization test does not supply.
trigger: test_quant_dequant reaches regularize with its unchanged K/seed-only quant_args dictionary.
expected_behavior: The repository caller supplies the new policy or omission defaults to automatic mode.
actual_behavior: quant_args['apply_out_scales'] raises KeyError. The test also already lacks devices, required later by the parent implementation; this is an additional incompatibility, not evidence that the test previously passed.

verification.description: Whole-tree caller and quant_args searches identified the converter and test builders; Linear.convert_exl3 forwards the dictionary unchanged. The converter is updated, the test is not.
verification.limits: Conditional on reaching regularize; the CUDA/model-dependent test was not run.
